title: RAW_UNSCREENED: ctho-daiin als Abkürzungsform oder zwei Felder
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f32v.8 has ZL/IT ctho daiin but RF cthodaiin; f32v.9 has neighboring two-field sequence.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed source lines and cached report outputs; no new selectors, images or reserves.
design.mechanism: Abbreviation reading treats fused/split writing as one compact semantic unit; field reading treats ctho and daiin as independent cells.
design.unit: Exact whole-form occurrences at the named loci.
design.contrast: Reader-invariant abbreviation versus boundary-sensitive field scope
design.prediction: Abbreviation predicts invariant downstream scope under fused/split presentation; two-field reading predicts changed field count or scope.
concrete_observations: GDT809 documents exact ZL/IT versus RF boundary difference at f32v.8 and chocthy daiin cthaiin daiin at f32v.9.
linked_consequences: Abbreviation requires reader-invariant downstream role without component export; two-field reading requires reproducible boundary-sensitive scope.
design.nearest_rival: Reader-invariant abbreviation versus boundary-sensitive field scope
design.distinguishing_observation: Compare reader-native boundaries and downstream scope only; alternate readings are not independent witnesses.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Boundary variation may be transcriptional and cannot by itself supply semantic evidence.
